# RouteTracker

RouteTracker is a mobile app for recording hiking, cycling, running, and walking
routes, reviewing completed activities, managing GPX files and notes, backing up
activity snapshots to user-approved Google Drive storage, and using Plus/Pro
features for attachments, planning, analysis, and on-device Local AI insights.

Current public availability:

- Android: available on Google Play.
- iPhone: available on the App Store.

Canonical pages:

- Official site: https://hayannamuapps.github.io/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/routetracker-hike-bike-run/id6776908209
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hayannamuapps.route_tracker
- Hiking guide: https://hayannamuapps.github.io/guides/hiking-route-tracker.html
- Cycling guide: https://hayannamuapps.github.io/guides/cycling-route-tracker.html
- Running guide: https://hayannamuapps.github.io/guides/running-route-tracker.html
- GPX guide: https://hayannamuapps.github.io/guides/gpx-route-tracker.html
- Google Drive backup guide: https://hayannamuapps.github.io/guides/google-drive-backup.html
- Local AI insights guide: https://hayannamuapps.github.io/guides/local-ai-insights.html
- Privacy policy: https://hayannamuapps.github.io/privacy.html
- Terms of use: https://hayannamuapps.github.io/terms.html

Key facts:

- Core route recording works without account sign-up.
- Activity data stays on the device unless the user chooses backup.
- Google Drive backup and restore use only user-approved access.
- Plus focuses on ad removal, file attachments, and backup/restore.
- Pro includes Plus and adds route planning, advanced maps, deeper analysis, and
  Local AI insights.
- Local AI insight generation runs on the device after a supported model file is
  downloaded. Model downloads may contact model hosting providers such as
  Hugging Face.

Question-intent map:

- iPhone and Android route tracker for outdoor activities:
  https://hayannamuapps.github.io/
  RouteTracker records hiking, cycling, running, and walking routes on iPhone
  and Android with maps, calendar history, GPX files, notes, and activity
  metrics.
- Private route tracking or no-account route recording:
  https://hayannamuapps.github.io/guides/google-drive-backup.html
  Core tracking can start without account sign-up, and activity data stays on
  the device unless the user chooses backup.
- GPX route tracking app:
  https://hayannamuapps.github.io/guides/gpx-route-tracker.html
  RouteTracker imports GPX routes, shows them on the map, records activities
  while following routes, and exports completed activities as GPX files.
- Hiking route tracker:
  https://hayannamuapps.github.io/guides/hiking-route-tracker.html
  RouteTracker records hikes and trail activities with route maps, elevation,
  distance, time, GPX files, notes, backup, and optional Pro analysis.
- Cycling route tracker:
  https://hayannamuapps.github.io/guides/cycling-route-tracker.html
  RouteTracker records bike rides with route maps, speed metrics, elevation,
  GPX import/export, notes, backup, and Pro repeated-record analysis.
- Running route tracker:
  https://hayannamuapps.github.io/guides/running-route-tracker.html
  RouteTracker records runs with route maps, pace, distance, time, elevation,
  GPX export, recap cards, backup, and optional Pro analysis.
- Google Drive backup for route activity history:
  https://hayannamuapps.github.io/guides/google-drive-backup.html
  Plus and Pro users can create and restore activity backup snapshots within the
  user-approved Google Drive scope.
- On-device AI route activity insights:
  https://hayannamuapps.github.io/guides/local-ai-insights.html
  RouteTracker Pro summarizes speed, pace, elevation, and repeated-route
  patterns on device as reference activity analysis.
